verdict.rationale: Neon documents its own slow-query and database-health tooling: the MCP server's "List Slow Queries" tool, and `inspect_database` / `neon inspect db`. These run 15 read-only checks covering index sizes, unused indexes, stalled queries, cache hit rate and bloat, which covers part of the slow-query and metrics story. However, this is exposed through MCP and CLI tools rather than a built-in insights view, and only unused-index detection is shown, not true index recommendations. Missing for 10: a documented console insights or monitoring dashboard, explicit index recommendations, time-series performance metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see slow queries, index recommendations, and performance metrics in a built-in insights view

citations.quote: exposes the same 15 read-only checks as `neon inspect db` (table/index sizes, unused indexes, stalled queries with waits and blockers, cache hit rate, bloat, replication state)
